A cookies file lets the downloader use your signed-in YouTube session. Use your own account and only if a video needs it.
1. On a computer, install a browser extension that exports cookies in Netscape format (cookies.txt).
2. Sign in to YouTube in that browser and open youtube.com.
3. Export the cookies file for youtube.com.
4. Copy the file to your phone (or download it there).
5. Tap Import cookies here and choose the file. If sign-in errors return later, export a fresh file and import it again.
